shortDescription: Manage rpm repositories of a pulp api server instance

options.name: autopublish
options.description: Whether to automatically create publications for new repository versions

options.name: description
options.description: An optional description of the repository

options.name: name
options.description: A unique name of the repository to query or manipulate Required for Create, Update, and Destroy operations If no value is specified, returns a list of all repositories

options.name: password
options.description: Password of api user. If no value is specified, the value of the environment variable C(SQUEEZER_PASSWORD) will be used as a fallback.

options.name: pulp_labels
options.description: A dictionary assigning pulp labels using string keys and values

options.name: pulp_url
options.description: URL of the server to connect to (without 'pulp/api/v3'). If no value is specified, the value of the environment variable C(SQUEEZER_PULP_URL) will be used as a fallback.

options.name: refresh_api_cache
options.description: Whether the cached API specification should be invalidated. It is recommended to use this once with the M(pulp.squeezer.status) module at the beginning of the playbook.

options.name: remote
options.description: An optional remote to use by default when syncing

options.name: repo_config
options.description: A JSON document or data structure describing a config.repo file

options.name: retain_package_versions
options.description: Max number of latest versions of each package to keep

options.name: retain_repo_versions
options.description: Max number of repository versions to keep

options.name: state
options.description: State the entity should be in

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time in seconds to wait for tasks.

options.name: user_key
options.description: Client certificate key of api user.

options.name: username
options.description: Username of api user. If no value is specified, the value of the environment variable C(SQUEEZER_USERNAME) will be used as a fallback.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether SSL certificates should be verified. If no value is specified, the value of the environment variable C(SQUEEZER_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used as a fallback.
